scripts.build: npm run build -w @agv/core && npm run build -w @agv/broker && npm run build -w @agv/server && npm run build -w @agv/simulator && npm run build -w @agv/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agv/core && concurrently -n core,broker,server,sim,web -c cyan,blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @agv/core" "npm run dev -w @agv/broker" "npm run dev -w @agv/server" "npm run dev -w @agv/simulator" "npm run dev -w @agv/web"
